tasks.label: Quality Check: Concrete Override Audit
tasks.command: Write-Host '=== CONCRETE OVERRIDE AUDIT ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $root = 'c:\_src\app-mvplounge-meshfactory\src\MvpLounge\MeshFactory\Element'; $approved = @{ 'RadioInput' = @('__process_checked'); 'SelectOptions' = @('__process_selected','getFactoryElementSelectValue','getFactoryElementSelectSelected'); 'TableBody' = @('getFactoryElementTableCellspacing','getFactoryElementTableCellpadding','getFactoryElementTableBorder') }; $phpFiles = Get-ChildItem $root -Recurse -Filter '*.php' | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'index.php' }; $classExtends = @(); foreach ($f in $phpFiles) { $content = Get-Content -Raw $f.FullName; if ($content -match 'class\s+(\w+)\s+extends\s+(\w+)') { $classExtends += [pscustomobject]@{ File = $f.FullName; Class = $matches[1]; Parent = $matches[2] } } }; $derivedParents = $classExtends.Parent | Sort-Object -Unique; $violations = @(); foreach ($f in $phpFiles) { $content = Get-Content -Raw $f.FullName; if ($content -match 'class\s+(\w+)\s+extends\s+(\w+)') { $className = $matches[1]; $processMethods = [regex]::Matches($content, 'function\s+(__process_\w+)\s*\(') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }; $getterMethods = [regex]::Matches($content, 'function\s+(getFactoryElement\w+)\s*\(') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }; $localMethods = @((@($processMethods) + @($getterMethods)) | Sort-Object -Unique); if ($localMethods.Count -eq 0) { continue }; if ($derivedParents -contains $className) { continue }; $approvedMethods = @(); if ($approved.ContainsKey($className)) { $approvedMethods = $approved[$className] }; $unapproved = @($localMethods | Where-Object { $_ -notin $approvedMethods }); if ($unapproved.Count -gt 0) { $violations += [pscustomobject]@{ Class = $className; File = $f.FullName; Methods = ($unapproved -join ', ') } } } }; if ($violations.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host 'FAIL Unapproved concrete overrides detected:' -ForegroundColor Red; $violations | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host ('Result: ' + $violations.Count + ' class violations') -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }; Write-Host 'PASS No unapproved concrete overrides detected.' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ('Approved exceptions tracked: ' + $approved.Count) -ForegroundColor Yellow
